device.type: DVB-S2 + DVB-T2/C Full HD H.265/HEVC combo receiver with CA card reader, Ethernet and USB Wi-Fi
device.board: 6A000100 (bootloader version "M3526A 1.1.1", 8 MB SPI flash, 256 MB DDR3 C3505 combo platform)
device.soc: ALi M3526A / C3505 with 256 MB DDR3 (bootloader "M3526A 1.1.1", seecode "M3606 SEE" at 0xAE000200)
device.demod: internal DVB-S2 (NIM_S3505_0) + external Availink AVL6762 / AVL6862 DVB-T2/C on bit-banged GPIO 103 / 105

source.site: satedu.cba.pl (a mirror of the Edision firmware archive)
source.author: Edision
source.note: Archive piccollino_S2T2C_v.1539.zip from the Edison directory on satedu.cba.pl; fetched 2026-11-02.

simulator.note: Boots as a 256 MB DDR3 C3505 / M3526A board on an 8 MB SPI flash (chips/c3505.py, run_dump_piccollino_s2_t2c_app_starts.py, run_dump_piccollino_s2_t2c_capture_screen.py): the boot-ROM bootloader runs in boot SRAM at 0x9FE00800, copies itself to 0x81000000, sets 0xB8000220 bit 24 to remap physical 0x0F000000..0x0FFFFFFF to the top 16 MB of DDR, shows the boot logo through VideoOutputM36F (video_m36.py, VSync interrupts on IC line 2), unpacks seecode ("M3606 SEE" at 0x3F0000) to 0xAE000200 and maincode(AV) (at 0x060000) to 0x80000200, and starts both cores (main EBase 0x80002000, SEE EBase 0x8E002001).  The application drives the CH455 front panel on GPIO 107 / 110 (" ON ", " on "), completes 6,541 SEE RPC calls including DSC Command Queue (crypto_engine.py CMDQ) and MCAS database initialisation, and renders its 1280x720 ARGB8888 OSD through the display engine at 0xB8006900 (without the board's anti-clone security IC it displays the hardware-ID warning dialog).

desc: Edision Piccollino S2+T2/C (System ID 6A000100) firmware v.1539 (2021-01-19) for the Full HD H.265/HEVC DVB-S2 + DVB-T2/C combo receiver on the ALi M3526A / C3505 SoC with 256 MB DDR3 and an 8 MB SPI flash.

Uses a 0x060000 bootloader offset with maincode(AV) at 0x060000 and seecode ("M3606 SEE") at 0x3F0000 (unpacked to 0xAE000200 in upper DDR3), a CH455 4-digit LED panel on GPIO 107 / 110, and the Edision 0x60xx remote control table ("necfirst" coding).
